title: Stage C — Corpus-B targeted extraction, v2.3.0-C

enum: refinery or petrochemical named but not an empirical application here

model_id.description: unique across the WHOLE record, not just within this application: mechanisms refer to model ids globally

label_verbatim.description: how the paper refers to this model, e.g. 'MLR model', 'Eq. (4)', 'the ANN'

C3_variables.description: One entry per variable the paper associates with this model. Empty array only for an unfitted absolute indicator with no denominator.

verbatim.description: the variable EXACTLY as the paper names it

page_as_recorded.description: PIPELINE FIELD, never written by an extracting surface: the page the surface cited, kept when the grounding check found the sentence verbatim on exactly one other page and corrected the locator.

locator_corrected.description: PIPELINE FIELD, never written by an extracting surface. True means `page` was corrected by the grounding check and the cell is queued for human review.

C5_measurement.description: One entry per energy vector whose measurement the paper describes. data_origin and boundary_correspondence are INDEPENDENT: an invoice can match the boundary exactly, a historian tag can be a calculated value. At least one entry: a model of energy performance always has an energy quantity, and where it comes from is either stated or 'not reported'. An empty array would be indistinguishable from 'not searched'.

absence_basis.description: MANDATORY when value is 'not reported' or 'explicitly absent'. Never invent a quote to justify an absence.

other_verbatim.description: MANDATORY when value is 'other' (or a list containing 'other'): the paper's own wording. An 'other' with no verbatim is an uninterpretable record.

locator_corrected.description: PIPELINE FIELD, never written by an extracting surface. True means `page` was corrected by the grounding check and the cell is queued for human review.

C12_method_data_requirements.description: What data and metadata this method needs to be reproduced elsewhere. FACTUAL, from the paper. Never a transferability verdict.

basis.description: MANDATORY when value is 'not reported' or 'explicitly absent'. Never invent a quote to justify an absence.

C3_variables_absence.description: MANDATORY when C3_variables is empty. A model with no explanatory variable (a mean or a ratio) is a finding; an unsearched empty array is not.

enum: not one of the registered sectors

claim_status.description: A textbook definition is 'general'. Only 'applied to the case' and 'empirically demonstrated' count toward the SQ2 headline figure.

mechanism_cause.description: The PHYSICAL or operational cause, when the paper names one. 'not stated' is the common and expected answer: most papers report what breaks, not why.

enum: data quality — missing, erroneous or discontinuous data
insufficient data length for the model
mechanism_effect_on_model.description: What it does to the energy performance model. This is what the paper almost always states. 'not stated' only if the paper names a cause with no stated consequence.

locator_corrected.description: PIPELINE FIELD, never written by an extracting surface. True means `page` was corrected by the grounding check and the cell is queued for human review.

items.description: One occurrence per distinct limitation the paper states. Cause and effect are SEPARATE axes: 'fouling makes the baseline drift' is ONE occurrence with cause=fouling and effect=baseline drift or expiry, not two or three competing labels. At least one of the two must be other than 'not stated'.

mechanisms.description: Empty array = the paper identifies no model limitation. That is a finding, not a gap.

addresses_mechanism.description: mechanism_id the paper explicitly links this to, else null. Never infer the link.

refers_to.description: the model_id this adapts, or an application_id, or 'paper-level argument'
